sb.title: Side bets
sb.subtitle: Extra wagers on the next wave only
sb.how1: Tick any side bet before you throw. Each one costs the stake shown on top (up to your main bet).
sb.how2: Its odds depend on how wide your cut is, so they appear once you set the cut.
sb.how3: It is settled on that one wave, win or lose, whatever happens to your main bet. A win is paid to your credit as stake × odds; it does not raise the main multiplier.
sb.how4: Ticked side bets stay on for the next waves until you untick them.

sb.odds_later: odds appear once you set a cut
sb.note: Side bet wins go straight to your credit. They do not change the multiplier of your main bet.

desc.mega_combo: Pays if {n} or more fruits land in your cut and no bomb does. Needs a cut of at least {n} lanes.
desc.clean_sheet: Pays if every fruit of the wave lands in your cut and no bomb does. Wider cuts make it likelier.
desc.dragon_fruit: A golden dragon fruit turns up in about 1 wave in {n}. Pays if it lands in your cut and no bomb does.
desc.insurance: Pays if a bomb lands in your cut. Use it to hedge the main bet on a risky wave.
desc.shield: From wave {level}. If a bomb lands in your cut, the shield takes the blast: your multiplier drops one step and you replay the wave. It does not save a cut with no fruit.

skins.title: BLADES
skins.text: A new blade trail every 100 cleared waves. Blades are cosmetic and never change the odds.
fair.title: PROVABLY FAIR
fair.intro: Every wave is built from HMAC_SHA256(server_seed, client_seed:nonce:wave): words 0-6 shuffle the lanes, word 7 places the dragon fruit. Your cut is stored before the wave is built. You see the SHA-256 of the server seed now and the seed itself when you rotate.
fair.legend: (F fruit, B bomb, - empty; lane 1 first)
rules.title: HOW TO PLAY
rules.intro: Fruit Slash is a step crash game played over {lanes} lanes. Place a bet, then before every wave swipe across the lanes to set your cut. Press THROW: your cut is locked in and only then the wave is thrown — fruit, bombs and empty lanes.
rules.li1: Every fruit in your cut is sliced and raises the multiplier; more fruit in one cut pays more.
rules.li2: A bomb in your cut ends the round. A cut with no fruit in it also ends the round.
rules.li3: Cash out after any cleared wave. Clearing wave {levels} cashes out automatically.
rules.li4: A wider cut catches more fruit and more risk. The chance and the multipliers for your width are shown before you throw.
rules.waves_note: F = fruit, B = bombs, the rest of the {lanes} lanes are empty. Which lane holds what is decided by the fair hash after your cut is locked.
rules.sides_text: Pick side bets and a stake (up to your bet) before a wave. Their odds depend on the width of your cut and settle on that wave.
rules.shield_text: From wave {level}, buy a shield for the next wave. If a bomb is in your cut, the shield absorbs it: the multiplier goes back one step and you play the same wave again. It does not cover a cut with no fruit. Price = chance of a bomb in your cut × the multiplier it keeps (RTP {rtp}).
rules.shield_off: The Samurai Shield is not offered by this casino.
rules.rtp_text: Theoretical RTP of the main bet: {rtp} for any cut widths and any cash-out point (every wave is priced so its average return is exactly the stake; multipliers are rounded to 0.01). Maximum win {max}× bet: a width is only offered while its best result stays within it.
rules.fair_text: The lanes of every wave come from HMAC-SHA256 of the server seed (its hash is shown before you play), your client seed, the round nonce and the wave number. Your cut is stored before that wave is built, so neither side can change the result. Rotate the seed in FAIR to check every wave you played.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays. An unfinished round is kept and restored the next time you open the game.
